newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea detains 20 ethnic Koreans on Chinese boat.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea detains 20 ethnic Koreans on Chinese boat.

text.p: South Korean maritime police said on Sunday they arrested a Chinese boat with more than 20 ethnic Koreans on board off the country's west coast.
A police officer in Kunsan said the small wooden boat was detained late on Saturday about three miles southwest of Wido island off the west coast of Cholla province.
"There were 21 ethnic Koreans and one Chinese. They seem to have come to find jobs here," the officer said.
More than 10,000 ethnic Koreans from China were believed to work illegally in South Korean companies, according to the justice ministry.
The boat was towed to Kunsan harbour on Sunday morning and those on board were under investigation by the police.
